scripts.prepare:site: npm run prepare:images && python3 build.py && node tools/bundle-feedback.mjs && python3 build-public.py && node tools/build-social-images.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prepare:site && astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.test: node tools/run-tests.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.build:release: npm run prepare:site && python3 build-public.py --release && node tools/build-social-images.mjs && astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.build:discovery: npm run prepare:images && python3 build.py && node tools/bundle-feedback.mjs && python3 build-public.py --discoverable && node tools/build-social-images.mjs && astro build && pagefind --site dist
